ei.subject: 2025년 6월 고3 모의고사
ei.title: 함축의미 — the boost is grounded in fiction

fullPassage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you ①<u>performed</u> well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and ②<u>finding</u> the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and ③<u>conclude</u> that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than ④<u>usual</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② finding → found: 'was having an off day and found'에서 and로 병렬, 과거시제.
det.analysis:
❌ ② finding: and로 병렬 → was having ... and found
✅ ① performed: 과거시제
✅ ③ conclude: 현재시제(일반적 서술)
✅ ④ usual: 형용사(보통의)
det.tip: and 병렬: was having ... and found (과거시제 일치)

questions.passage: Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be ①<u>involved</u>. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially ②<u>favorable</u> conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb ③<u>particular</u> well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take ④<u>credit</u> for.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ particular → particularly: 동사 climb을 수식 → 부사 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ particular: climb(동사) 수식 → particularly(부사)
✅ ① involved: 과거분사(수동)
✅ ② favorable: 형용사(유리한)
✅ ④ credit: 명사(공로)
det.tip: climb particularly well: 부사 + 부사 → 동사 수식

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. det.korean: ② putting → put: 과거시제 문맥에서 'you put in'이 원문.
det.analysis:
❌ ② putting: you put in(과거시제) → put
✅ ① better: 비교급(no better than)
✅ ③ are: 주어 feelings(복수) 일치
✅ ④ boost: 현재시제(가정)
det.tip: put-put-put: 불규칙 변화, 과거도 put

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance ①<u>puts</u> you at the whim of external factors. Comparison is one source of illusion. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ involving → involved: 'may be involved'(수동) — 요인이 관련되다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ involving: be involved(수동) — 주어가 '관련되는' 대상
✅ ① puts: 현재시제 단수 일치
✅ ② were climbing: 과거진행형
✅ ④ grounded: be grounded in(~에 근거하다)
det.tip: be involved(관련되다, 수동) vs involving(~을 포함하는, 능동)

det.korean: 자신의 공로(credit)로 돌릴 수 없다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① credit: take credit for(공로로 돌리다)
❌ ② responsibility(책임): 맥락 부적합
❌ ③ blame(비난): 반대 개념
❌ ④ advantage(이점): 관용구 없음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ subjectively(주관적으로) → 원문 objectively(객관적으로). 실제로는 '객관적으로' 강한 수행.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ subjectively: 원문 objectively → 객관적 사실
✅ ① external: 원문 일치(외부의)
✅ ② usual: 원문 일치(보통의)
✅ ④ fiction: 원문 일치(허구)
det.tip: objectively(객관적으로) ↔ subjectively(주관적으로)

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. ____. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.
